title: C++ Hello World and Basics
content:
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;                                   // std namespace use karo

int main() {                                           // main function — yahan se shuru hota hai
    cout << "Hello, World!" << endl;                   // output print karo
    cout << "Welcome to QueryNest!" << endl;           // output print karo

    // Variables
    int age = 20;                                      // integer variable
    double marks = 92.5;                               // double precision decimal
    string name = "Alice";                             // string variable
    bool active = true;                                // boolean variable

    cout << "Name: " << name << ", Age: " << age << ", Marks: " << marks << endl; // output print karo
    cout << "Active: " << boolalpha << active << endl; // output print karo
    return 0;                                          // value return karo
}
